atoms.requirement: Use actual Band Desktop.
Band coordinates the agent team.
Agents share one actual room.
At least two agents participate.
Lead/architect writes the plan in the room.
Team works from one plan.
Team uses one shared work board.
Agents claim work items.
Actual task transitions include To-do and Done.
Agents address each other with mentions.
Agents hand context directly to other agents.
Handoff succeeds without human copying.
At least one real decision or approval occurs.
Human receives that decision through Band.
Decision is not hard-coded.
Demo shows Band Desktop rooms.
Demo shows the work board.
Demo shows per-agent sessions.
Demo shows token counts.
Demo shows estimated costs.
Use Cognee Open Source.
Cognee serves as working memory.
Demonstrate working memory rather than only static storage.
Agents write memory while doing the task.
Agents actually recall stored memory.
Recalled memory changes a subsequent action.
Demonstrate recall after restart OR between different agents; either is sufficient.
BAND is essential: removing it changes required product behavior.
Cognee is essential: removing it changes required product behavior.
Address qualitative deep-integration review; Boolean tests alone do not guarantee qualification.
Use different agent harnesses for higher-scoring collaboration.
Demonstrate improve OR forget OR graph-backend connection; preserve this alternative choice.
Send and read back actual usage events in Flexprice test mode.
Connect those events to a configured test pricing model.
Demonstrate product behavior driven by metering.
Optional example: credits gate a feature.
Optional alternative example: observed BAND costs pass through to test billing.
Use a real Snyk scanning product; alternatives are not all mandatory.
Scan the exact artifact built by the agents.
Give security review an actual team role.
Security reviewer participates in the BAND room.
Security reviewer runs Snyk scans.
Security reviewer posts actual findings.
A finding actually blocks completion until a verified fix.
Store recurring issue evidence in Cognee working memory.
Demonstrate recalled security memory changes behavior on a repeated task.

note: Static custody projection, not live BAND/Cognee. All status updates require evidence-bound successors.
